correctness.rationale: Exact spectrum = directed walk edge set in the finite de Bruijn graph, and no repeated factors = an edge-simple directed trail. Exhaustive BFS over (vertex,seen-mask) states is complete even for arbitrarily long walks, since all possible state cycles are traversed through reachability closure. Two independent implementations, graph SCC condensation and mask-state BFS, agree on every one of 255 and 65535 possible nonempty masks. A second BFS with repeats forbidden determines exact lossless counts. A direct word enumeration independently confirms the 121 3-gram profiles; two four-edge obstructions have explicit words and no lossless trail. Checker replay passed.
